Subject: Need help with a breach of contract case

Hello, my name is Harpreet Pawar. I am a 72-year-old restaurant owner living in Mangaluru. Our company has a breach of contract claim of ₹16.1 crore against Deccan Logistics Ltd, and the counterparty has not paid the invoices for delivered goods. My case number is CS(COMM) 681/2025 in the Mangaluru Commercial Court. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 76524 73557 or email harpreet.pawar@example.in.
